[SWS_EthIf_00687]Derivation of the EthSwtPort link state used for the link state
accumulation
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00033, FO_RS_MACsec_00002
⌈EthIf shall consider the following rules for the link state derivation per EthSwtPort
as prerequisite for the link state accumulation:
• If an EthSwtPort belongs to an EthIfSwitchPortGroup which is referenced
by an EthIfController that references a MkaPaeInstance that protects this
EthSwtPort, then the link state of this EthSwtPort shall be considered as
ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_
